rationale: convert_resume_timestamp_spec returns Result<bool, bool> with bool as a stand-in for opaque production types (chrono DateTime<Utc> on Ok and RuntimeError::ResumeTimestampOverflow { run, timestamp } on Err). This is a documented design choice because Verus spec fns cannot carry chrono or RuntimeError types. The verification target is the i64 boundary (TB-002), and the exec proofs at lines 330-359 exercise the boundary cases (0, i64::MAX as u64, +1, u64::MAX, realistic 1_700_000_000) through the mirror exec fn — so the totality contract is non-vacuous.
